summary_md: **Arthur. ([@ArthurLiu0725](https://x.com/ArthurLiu0725/status/2115396040417505736))** (in Chinese) explains Google's open-source **Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM)** plugin: one AI drafts a design with full project context and a second, starting from a clean context, hunts for hidden assumptions and logic gaps, turning it into an explore, draft-spec, independent-review flow. The article links the google/elephant-goldfish-model repo and Google's open-source blog post.
relevance: A fresh-context reviewer pattern from Google for spec-first agentic coding.
